messages:
mira: FYI: multiple tenants reported SSO failures starting ~00:10 UTC after IdP cert rotation. Symptoms: SAML signature verify errors + some SCIM deprovision 403s.

alex: Which IdP and which cert rotation job? Any quick correlation to recent RBAC/tenant-id changes?

mira: Okta rotation. We also merged a tenant-id normalization change this week (short ids -> canonical with -org). Might be related.

sam: SCIM logs show failures like: 
```
HTTP 403 Forbidden - key_unwrap_failed
{"reason":"kms:context_mismatch","expected":"tenant:acme-org","got":"tenant:acme"}
```

jordan: That smells like a KMS context mismatch, not pure SAML. But SAML errors could be caused by edge nodes with stale IdP cert caches. Two separate failure modes chaining together.

priya: Can we capture a failing SAML response (sanitized) and check SignatureMethod & KeyInfo? Need to confirm algorithm and thumbprint.

mira: Sanitized snippet pasted: 
```
<samlp:Response>
  <Assertion>
    <Subject>
      <NameID Format=\"urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:nameid-format:persistent\">user-197</NameID>
    </Subject>
    <Signature>
      <SignedInfo>
        <SignatureMethod Algorithm=\"http://www.w3.org/2001/04/xmldsig-more#rsa-sha1\" />
      </SignedInfo>
    </Signature>
  </Assertion>
</samlp:Response>
```

alex: Ah, RSA-SHA1 - some of our verifiers are hardened to only accept SHA256. If IdP rotated to an older algo that could break validation on nodes that enforce the stricter policy.

ops-bot: Checking cert cache status across edges... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: edge-2 cert fingerprint: 0xAA11... (current)
ops-bot: edge-14 cert fingerprint: 0xBB22... (stale) -> last refresh 2026-03-18T23:40Z

jordan: edge-14 stale. That explains SAML signature verify fails on that node. We'll force refresh.

ops-bot: Forcing metadata refresh on edge-14... :wrench:
ops-bot: Refresh complete at 00:25 UTC, new fingerprint: 0xAA11...

mira: After refresh, SAML verifies on that node. But SCIM deprov for tenant acme-org still errors with KMS context mismatch.

sam: Debugging SCIM unwrap: 
```
unwrap request: alias=projects/prod/keys/tenant-acme
wrappedKey.header={"alg":"RSA-OAEP","ctx":"tenant:acme"}
kms error: expected_ctx=tenant:acme-org -> mismatch
```

priya: We did tenant-id normalization (acme -> acme-org) in RBAC last week. Some older wrapped keys still have the old ctx. Most services consult tenant-alias map, but SCIM's unwrap path bypasses alias translation. That's the gap.

alex: Short-term mitigation: add a compat mapping in SCIM KMS client to accept legacy ctx values when validating unwrap. Also add better error classification so we don't surface a vague 403 to customers.

mira: Agreed. I'll open a quick PR for a header-compat hook. Can we also run a query to list tenants with wrapped keys using legacy ctx (for audit/compliance)?

sam: Querying KMS metadata store... returns ~47 key blobs with legacy ctx across 12 tenants. I'll export and redact PII.

jordan: Long-term: plan a rewrap migration to canonical ctx + store rewrap audit entries (operator, timestamp, before/after fingerprint). Legal/compliance will want the audit trail.

priya: Also add a probe to the provisioning pipeline to detect when NameID format or NameID value semantics change (so we don't get silent mismatches that trigger deprovs).

alex: Patch landed for compat hook, rolling to staging. Re-run deprov for sample tenant: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://scim.prod/repro -d '{"tenant":"acme-org","user":"user-197","action":"deprov-dryrun"}' -H 'Authorization: ReproToken'
```

sam: Dry-run succeeded in staging with compat hook. Prod replay queued after canary. :white_check_mark:

mira: Follow-ups tracked: 
- Rewrap migration job (ops + infra) with audit log export (owner=jordan)
- SCIM client hardening + better 4xx/5xx classification (owner=priya)
- Edge cache monitoring rule to fail fast if fingerprints diverge (owner=ops)

jordan: I'll draft RFC-1429 for the migration and the required compliance controls for key rewrap (retain pre-wrap fingerprints, operator id, signed job manifest).

mira: Also flagging a vuln-triage: if an attacker could force a tenant id rename mismatch, could they induce KMS unwrap failures and cause denial-of-service for deprov flows? We should assess blast radius.

alex: Good catch. Adding security review to the RFC and running a threat model. Priya, can you add this to vuln-triage board?

priya: Done. Added ticket SEC-PT-990 with high/medium severity assessment to follow.

mira: I'll notify legal/compliance with the audit plan and the list of affected tenant artifacts.

ops-bot: Incident record created: SSO-OKTA-CERT-2026-03-20 status=mitigated owner=mira followups=[RFC-1429,REWRAP-2026]

alex: Thanks team. Keeping thread open until rewrap job and audit are complete. If anything new surfaces, reply here.

mira: Closing the active mitigation loop for now. Will post postmortem once RFC lands. :memo:
